# MDLinx

> > MDLinx delivers clinical news, practice insights, and emerging medical research for physicians across specialties, with focus on precision oncology, healthcare technology, and practice management.

MDLinx serves as a professional resource for physicians, featuring expert commentary from institutions like USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center and UCSF, coverage of major conferences like ESMO 2026, and practical guidance on AI adoption, financial challenges, and evidence-based clinical approaches. The platform bridges cutting-edge research with real-world physician experiences.

## Key Topics

- Precision oncology and rare tumors
- Healthcare AI and clinical technology
- ESMO 2026 and sarcoma research
- Private practice management
- Neurology and tauopathies
- Inflammatory bowel disease (UC/CD)
- Molecular therapy and immunotherapy
- Digital wellness and social media health
- Evidence-based supplementation
- Clinical trial innovations
- Awake craniotomy techniques
- Harm reduction strategies
- Healthcare financial sustainability
